body.title: Implement claimed-file checkpoint cleanup and recovery
body.summary: Add proposed cleanup.ts and post-approval hook outside store queue. Filter exact project/artifact, verify every preserved attempt and inactive ownership, then privately claim same-filesystem file before verification/deletion; quarantine mismatches and restore only without clobber.
acceptanceChecks: Never unlink public pathname: replacements before/after claim remain safe; unverified bytes retained with path/reason, crashes recover claims safely.
Retain active, foreign, corrupt, symlink, unpreserved and unfinished overridden state; release replay state only after actual deletion and no new public checkpoint; independent artifacts continue.

tests.name: I4 private claims, replacement races, full-history preservation and restart
I5 cleanup concurrency, fixed lock order and foreign-scope exclusion
